SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUN-09-2025 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUN-09-2025 BY VISITING JUDGE CINDEE MAYFIELD. APPEARANCES: PLAINTIFF SUVID TUBTIMCHAROON IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT LAKEWOOD APARTMENTS (JESSICA VAZQUEZ) IS PRESENT. CLERK: M. DE LUNA. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RETAINED. NOT REPORTED (D506)
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) JESSICA VAZQUEZ FILED BY DEFENDANT LAKEWOOD APARTMENTS (CAL-AMERICAN)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-09-2025 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF TUBTIMCHAROON, SUVID RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT LAKEWOOD APARTMENTS (CAL-AMERICAN) $4,350.00 PRINCIPAL, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $4,400.00, THE COURT FINDS THAT PROPERTY TOWED PLAINTIFF'S VEHICLE W/O GIVING NOTICE AS REQUIRED BY SECTION 29 OF LEASE. ADDITIONALLY, PLAINTIFF'S VEHICLE WAS "IN OPERATING CONDITION", REGISTERED AS "NON-OP", AND HAD A PARKING STICKER AT THE TIME IT WAS TOWED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
